text: oh wtf. nevermind. i just got a sliver of it to work. holdon.
resolution: Same root cause and fix as req_2696 (the two reports are one bug): the perfect-line split where only part of the map takes the picked material is the ground D stream truncating at the pooled buffer cap — the per-cell material tail rides at the END of the v3 stream, so exactly the first ~5.5k of 14.4k cells got their binding and the rest fell to the kind default. Fixed in aedd40840 by sizing GROUND_DATA_FLOATS to the v3 worst case (34000) and logging a loud one-shot error on any future overflow. After a Zig rebuild the picked material should apply across the whole chunk.
